title: ICE cotton retreats from multi-month highs on dollar pressure
content:
ICE cotton futures ended mixed after Monday’s sharp rally, as a stronger US dollar triggered profit-booking despite bullish USDA supply-demand estimates.
July 2026 cotton settled 1.65 per cent lower at 86.32 cents/lb, though volumes stayed exceptionally high.
Markets remained supported by tight supply expectations, while traders monitored US inflation, Fed outlook and US–China tariff uncertainty.

title: GFS 2026: Kering, H&M on putting sustainability back on the CFO agenda
content:
Global Fashion Summit (GFS) 2026 highlighted the CFO’s growing role in embedding sustainability into fashion’s financial decision-making.
As earnings calls focus more on margins, AI and geopolitics, sustainability mentions have declined by about one-third since 2022.
The BCG-GFA report says CFOs must help prioritise, fund and measure circularity, EPR readiness and long-term resilience.

title: India captures Europe's apparel sourcing pivot
content:
India has overtaken peers as Europe’s fastest-growing apparel supplier; EU-27 imports hit a record $6.96 billion in 2025, up 14.3 per cent YoY. 
Q1 surged 22.3 per cent, the strongest quarter in 4 years; home textiles climbed 18.6 per cent to $1.60 billion.
The zero-duty India-EU FTA wipes a 12 per cent tariff gap as Bangladesh logs 113 factory closures and Turkiye slides 11.3 per cent.

title: Canada, Vietnam seek broader trade cooperation
content:
Canada and Vietnam have agreed to further strengthen economic and trade ties as well as supply chain connectivity amid growing global uncertainties. 
The issue was discussed at a meeting between Minister of Industry and Trade Le Manh Hung and Canadian ambassador to Vietnam Jim Nickel, who highlighted Vietnam’s growing role in global supply chains. 
The two sides discussed talks on the ASEAN-Canada FTA.

title: Bangladesh’s BGMEA, OS Hub sign MoU to strengthen apparel transparency
content:
Bangladesh trade body BGMEA and US-based Open Supply Hub have signed an MoU to strengthen apparel sector transparency and digitally presenting factory information on the global supply chain platform.
The two sides will create an integrated digital database platform that will enable buyers to directly access information on the location, product categories and special capabilities of garment units.

title: RMG trade bodies seek policy support from Bangladesh PM
content:
Representatives of two top Bangladesh garment trade bodies recently met PM Tarique Rahman and urged him to ensure uninterrupted power and energy supply, quick release of export receipts from banks, reopening of closed factories and easing of customs regulations.
BKMEA raised concerns about misuse of the bond facility and urged action against violators of bond licences.

title: US’ Under Armour eyes gross margin improvement in FY27
content:
For FY27, Under Armour expects slight revenue decline and margin improvement. 
The company’s FY26 revenue fell 4 per cent to $5 billion, led by weaker North America sales, lower wholesale revenue, and a sharp footwear decline. 
Gross margin narrowed due to tariffs and cost pressures. 
In Q4, revenue slipped 1 per cent as North America weakened, though international and DTC sales grew.

title: Israel’s Delta Galil posts record Q1 sales on broad-based growth
content:
Delta Galil Industries has reported record Q1 2026 sales of $573 million, up 15 per cent YoY, with gross profit rising 18 per cent to $238.8 million. 
The gross margin improved to 41.7 per cent, supported by factory efficiency and favourable exchange rates. 
EBIT also reached a Q1 record, while the company reaffirmed its full-year 2026 guidance.
